scenarios.name: primary_process_termination
scenarios.recovery_action: Secondary waits for lease timeout, advances epoch, assumes authority

scenarios.name: minority_network_partition
scenarios.trigger: Leader isolated from 2 of 3 cluster nodes
scenarios.recovery_action: Leader abdicates on lease renewal failure (QuorumLossError); prevents rogue writes

scenarios.name: stale_leader_post_failover_reconnect
scenarios.trigger: Old primary awakens and attempts to write with Epoch 1
scenarios.recovery_action: Authoritative FencedWALWriter intercepts and rejects write via FencingTokenError

scenarios.name: concurrent_leadership_race
scenarios.trigger: Two nodes attempt election simultaneously without majority
scenarios.recovery_action: Quorum rule (N/2 + 1) blocks split leadership; at most one candidate prevails

scenarios.name: partition_healing_and_reintegration
scenarios.recovery_action: Demoted node rejoins as standby; syncs sequence head from active leader
